note: Set 2026-11-14 from laptop medians (macOS arm64, 5 load / 3 interaction iterations, two full runs) plus headroom. `baseline` is the median the budget was set from. Tighten both as fixes land. CI runs this check report-only until CI-hardware budgets are calibrated (see .github/workflows/perf-lab.yml).

load.mobile.signed-in-cold.articleMs.description: Time to article (first paragraph in the DOM), cold, signed-in, mobile profile. Run-to-run spread under 1%; ~15% headroom.

load.mobile.signed-in-cold.bytesBeforeAr.description: Bytes received before the article first appeared on that same load (867 KB JS in 52 files, 295 KB wasm, CSS, document, API). Nearly deterministic; ~85 KB headroom catches a real bundle regression.

interaction.cpu4.navLargeLongestTaskMs.description: Longest task while navigating by tree click to the 279 KB page (30 tables) at 4x CPU, first visit (body fetched). ~20% headroom.
